angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 598,302 km at 182.04 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.4932 +/- 0.0194 mas (same row, RUWE 1.32): 182.04 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.86 +/- 0.1 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-58 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJS..226....7C/abstract): 598,302 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.89 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Crossfield et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-58 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJS..226....7C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5413 +/- 255 K from Crossfield et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-58 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJS..226....7C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Crossfield et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-58 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJS..226....7C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-58.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.518, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-58 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.11 dex, from Mayo et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-58 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.39764, from Barros et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...594A.100B/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2599975224481836672, flags_flame 00: age_flame 12.124887 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 10.183866 to 13.5)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, K2-58: projected rotation speed 2.25 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2023A&A...676A..90R)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
